outcome_definition.primary: Time to finish eight independent 100 ps DHFR replicas on one GPU.
outcome_definition.secondary: Aggregate ns/day and per-replica mean/final potential energy in kJ/mol.
outcome_definition.scientific_goal: Preserve each replica scientific outcome while reducing ensemble wall time.
outcome_definition.reason: Supplied fixed-work driver has no independent published energy outcomes or acceptance tolerances.

evidence: Public OpenMM 8.2.0 Linux x86_64 wheels exist for CPython 3.10 through 3.13.
Public CUDA 12 plugin wheel exists for manylinux glibc 2.27/2.28 x86_64.
Plugin metadata requires NVIDIA CUDA runtime, NVCC, NVRTC, CUPTI and cuFFT packages.
Brief requires NVIDIA driver supporting CUDA 12.

unknowns: Stock image identity, architecture, Python and glibc versions
MPS binary, daemon permissions and GPU sharing support
Actual CUDA runtime compatibility and successful deterministic workload execution
stock_cuda_image_feasibility.reason: Public binaries support provisional feasibility, but stock image and driver evidence absent; pending reproduction. No known incompatibility established.

size_reason: No published or measured peak host/device memory for fixed-work eight-replica workload. Intake does not run workloads.

scoring_and_repeatability_rules.scientific_outputs: Match replica ids, seeds, step counts, final and mean potential energy in kJ/mol. Full-series equality requires additional instrumentation.
scoring_and_repeatability_rules.reason: No independently published fixed-work energy acceptance bound. Brief predictions are hypotheses; same-seed run-to-run variability is unmeasured.
scoring_and_repeatability_rules.anchor_interface: anchors.json contains only independent published reference; tolerance null prevents pass/fail scoring against approximate throughput.
comparison_preconditions: Same single GPU model and device
Same work, precision and deterministic-force properties
scoring_and_repeatability_rules.repeat_count_reason: No published repeat count or confidence rule for fixed-work ensemble.
scoring_and_repeatability_rules.repeatability: Force determinism documented for CUDA; whole stochastic-trajectory identity under concurrency unverified. CPU platform trial described in brief was nondeterministic.

anchor_scope: Published approximate throughput reference is fixed-time and distinct from fixed-work ensemble; no independently published acceptance bound. Brief speedup predictions excluded.
search_reason: No benchmark search performed. Only brief-linked primary sources verified; no substitute benchmark considered.

gate.note: Intake gate permits unknown stock feasibility; memory and reproducibility remain unmeasured.
